This is November 16th, 1978, and we're starting Reel 3 of the interview with Juan Tizol. Juan, yesterday when we wound up Reel 2, you said that today you wanted to talk about some of your tricks.
I've read about a couple of them in books, but I never saw any of them. Do you want to tell me about what you used to do?
